params.body:
Since gentells-site #170, a team member signs in on gentells.com with their Observatory password and gets the top plan. The mails still said the account opens the Studio and the Observatory only, and the old comment said gentells.com was deliberately left out.

- **Invite:** "One password opens both, and signs you in on gentells.com as well, where you read every trend, post and report."
- **Reset:** the text names the Studio, the Observatory and gentells.com. The subject is now "A new password for Gentells: Studio, Observatory and gentells.com". The site's "Forgot your password?" sends team members this mail.
- **Comment:** the comment above the templates is updated.

Tests: 961 passing.
params.title: Invite and reset mails: the account opens gentells.com too
